title: Ijaarsa Fayyinaa Jabaate
intro: Namni obsa guddaa fi amantii hin raafamne kan qabu, namni dhuunfaa kun waggoota lakkoofsa hin qabne ergama waaqummaaf kan of kenne yoo ta’u, tuffii fi diduu hin boqonne isa mudate. Seenaan isaanii kufrii humnaa ol ta’e keessatti amantiif ragaa cimaa ta’ee, taatee guddaa addunyaa kana irra deebi’ee boceen fiixee irra ga’a.
clues: Jireenya koo keessatti yeroo dheeraa haala nama ajaa’ibuun ummata koo gara ibaadaa Rabbiitti waamuun of kenne.
Sabni koo natti qoosuudhaan dogoggora mul’ataa fi maraatummaa natti himate.
Hawaasa koo isa lafaan marfameef waan hin baratamne fakkaatu akkan ijaaru ajajame.
Ijaarsa adda ta’e kana irratti ana fi maatii koo waliin kan amananii fi muraasni qofti.
Uumama lubbuu qabu hunda lama lama baadhadheen ture, akkuma Rabbiin qajeelfama kennetti.
Lolaan guddaan lafa liqimsee, warra meeshaa koo keessatti na waliin turan qofa baraare, ilmi koo ofii isaatii kufrii isaatiin ni bade.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
